name: list_invoices
title: List invoices
description:
List and search invoices with optional filters for status, payment state, Person or Company, and more.

    Supports filtering by invoice status (draft/issued/void), payment status, Person or Company, and archive state.
    Returns invoice number, Person or Company name, total, balance due, status, and due date.
    Use payment_status="overdue" (with order_by="due_date") to answer "who owes me?" / "what's overdue?".
    Responses include record ids; response_format='concise' returns trimmed rows (ids kept), 'detailed' adds links and secondary fields.

company_id.title: Company Id
company_id.description: Optional Company UUID filter, from list_companies.

person_id.title: Person Id
person_id.description: Optional Person UUID filter, from list_people.

response_format.title: Response Format
response_format.description: 'detailed' (default) matches today's full output, including links and secondary fields. 'concise' trims each row to essentials but always keeps '[id: ...]' for follow-up view/write tools.

name: view_invoice
title: View invoice
description:
View a specific invoice with full details including line items, payments, and totals.

    `identifier` accepts an invoice number (e.g., INV-001) or a UUID — the tool resolves
    either form. Returns complete invoice data including client info, line items, payment
    history, and status. In ChatGPT, renders an interactive invoice card.

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: Invoice number (e.g. INV-001) or invoice UUID. The tool resolves either form.

name: list_companies
title: List Companies
description: Search Companies. A Company can exist without People. Results include typed keys, avatars and profile versions; private fields obey your billing role. Page through has_more before treating results as complete.

exact_terms.description: Search the literal words. By default the server expands each term into its other forms.
exact_terms.title: Exact Terms

name: list_people
title: List People
description: Search People by name, email, phone or employer. Results include typed keys, avatars and profile versions. Page through has_more before treating results as complete.

name: create_invoice
title: Create invoice
description:
Create a draft invoice atomically with a new operation UUID and at least one line item.

    Set command.party to {kind: person|company, id: UUID} from list_people/list_companies;
    a draft may omit it until the recipient is known. No Company is created for a Person.
    Use business_settings for currency/tax defaults and list_services for service IDs.
    Omitted currency uses the business default; issue/due dates default to today/+30 days.
    New line items must not carry retained IDs. Retry identical inputs with the same
    operation UUID after an uncertain response; the same invoice is returned.

FinancialParty.description: The Person or Company an invoice, proposal, expense, or deal targets.
FinancialParty.title: FinancialParty

NewLineItem.description: A new line item for an invoice or proposal.

description.description: Description of the work or item
description.title: Description

quantity.description: Number of units. Omitted quantity is preserved on a retained item; new items default to one.
quantity.title: Quantity

unit_price.description: Price per unit; zero is valid.
unit_price.title: Unit Price

discount_applied.description: Discount percent (0–100) or fixed amount, according to discount_type.
discount_applied.title: Discount Applied

sales_tax_applied.description: Tax rate as a decimal, such as 0.13.
sales_tax_applied.title: Sales Tax Applied

NewLineItem.title: NewLineItem

operation_id.title: Operation Id
operation_id.description: Fresh UUID for this write; retry with the identical UUID after an uncertain response.

party.description: {kind: person|company, id: UUID}. May be omitted on a draft until the recipient is known.

due_date.title: Due Date
due_date.description: Optional due date. Defaults to 30 days from today.

issue_date.title: Issue Date
issue_date.description: Optional issue date. Defaults to today.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 currency code such as USD or CAD. Defaults to business_settings currency.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Optional customer-facing notes printed on the invoice.

is_online_payment_enabled.title: Is Online Payment Enabled
is_online_payment_enabled.description: Whether to enable online payment for this invoice when available.

name: list_deals
title: List deals
description:
Read pipeline deals as text and structured data without a display.

    Defaults to live, non-archived deals: approved deals assigned to a pipeline stage.
    Set review_state to pending, dismissed, approved, or all to inspect other review states.
    Use search for target name or company text. Set include_archived=True to include archived deals.

    Preserve record IDs in both formats. response_format='concise' returns trimmed rows. 'detailed' adds links and secondary fields.
    Use order_by and order_desc for custom sort order. Use limit and offset for pagination.

    Complete all data reads before any display. For one pipeline display, call list_workspace_deals(focus="overview") once.
    Pass supported stage/search filters to that tool. Use text for filters or sort orders that its bounded lanes cannot represent.
    

Approved Deal rows include their sales strategy and its target.

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: A stage key or label from get_pipeline_settings (e.g. 'lead', 'won', or a custom stage such as 'Discovery booked'); case-insensitive.

response_format.title: Response Format
response_format.description: 'detailed' (default) matches today's full output, including links and secondary fields. 'concise' trims each row to essentials but always keeps '[id: ...]' for follow-up view/write tools.

attention.description: Only Deals that need work, for any listed reason. These are the reasons Priorities uses: needs_reply (an unanswered reply), step_due (the plan has a next step and no wait), draft_ready (an unsent draft), stale (7 or more days in one stage). Approved Deals only. Each row gets an `attention` list.
attention.title: Attention

inactive_days.description: Only Deals with no activity for at least this many days (from last_activity_at).
inactive_days.title: Inactive Days

owner.description: Only Deals owned by this person: 'me', a teammate's email, or a user id.

updated_since.description: Only Deals changed at or after this ISO-8601 time. Use it to read what changed since the last run.

Move a deal to Lead, Opportunity, Won, or Lost.

    This is an operator/manual move and allows corrections such as moving out

    client; if not, the tool returns the client-resolution requirement.

stage.description: A stage key or label from get_pipeline_settings (e.g. 'lead', 'won', or a custom stage such as 'Discovery booked'); case-insensitive.
stage.title: Stage

name: ask_assistant
title: Ask assistant
description:
Read-only Q&A fallback. Use a specific tool first; reach for this only when no other tool fits.

    PREFER specific tools whenever the request maps to one:
    - Listing/filtering: list_invoices, list_people, list_companies, list_proposals, list_payments, list_expenses, list_services, list_deals, list_prospects, get_pipeline_summary
    - Lookup by id/number/name: view_invoice, view_person, view_company, view_proposal, view_deal, view_prospect
    - Read-only summaries: network_summary, get_daily_brief, get_scheduled_task_result, get_financial_report
    - Mutations: create_invoice, create_proposal, create_person, create_company, record_payment, send_invoice, create_deal, move_deal_stage, log_deal_activity, etc.
    - Capability/help: what_every_does for "what can Every do?", get_home for onboarding/welcome.

    USE THIS TOOL ONLY for analytical questions that span multiple data points and have no
    direct tool — e.g. "what's my revenue this quarter?", "which customers have the most
    overdue invoices?", "summarize my pipeline this month". It is read-only: writes,
    drafts, sends, deletes, and external MCP actions are refused. For changes, use the
    specific write tools (create_invoice, record_payment, send_invoice, create_deal,
    move_deal_stage, log_deal_activity, etc.).

    Simple questions answer in seconds on a warm conversation; complex analytical
    questions can take a minute or more, so keep first questions focused. Follow-up
    questions asked within about 30 minutes reuse the same conversation thread, so you
    can ask naturally without repeating earlier context.

message.title: Message
message.description: Fallback question for analysis that spans multiple data points (e.g. revenue, pipeline summaries, cross-entity rollups). Prefer specific tools — list_*, view_*, create_*, what_every_does, get_home — when one fits the request.

name: get_pipeline_settings
title: Get pipeline settings
description:
Read the org's pipeline (sales stage) settings: the ordered stages (key, label,
role), each stage's success criteria and whether the agent is allowed to move a deal
into it, plus whether Won automation is enabled overall. Stages are per workspace —
use a key or label from here wherever a tool takes a stage. Read-only — settings are
changed in the Every app.

name: update_deal
title: Update deal
description:
Change one or more fields of a Deal in one call. A field you leave out does not change.

Use the same field names as create_deal. Stage changes go through
move_deal_stage, sales strategy through set_deal_sales_strategy. The fields
apply in order (name, value_estimate, party, owner, members, goal). If one is
refused, the result names the fields already saved. Find the Deal with
list_deals. This replaces set_deal_name and set_deal_value_estimate.

name: deal_outreach
title: Deal outreach
description:
Edit, send or cancel the message that a Deal owes, on the Deal's own draft.

Read the draft and its draft_version and channel with
view_deal(include=["draft"]). edit returns the new draft_version. send takes
that draft_version and sends the current draft on its channel (email, or a
LinkedIn or Instagram direct message through the owner's connected
account). The send records on the plan step and the timeline, as a send
from the Deal does. It goes only to the recipient already on the draft, and
it waits for your approval in Every first. If the channel has no integrated
send or the account is not connected, the result returns the text to send
by hand. Use send_email only for mail that has no Deal.

action.description: edit changes the current draft. send sends it after your approval in Every. cancel stops a scheduled or held send.
action.title: Action

draft_version.description: The draft_version from view_deal(include=["draft"]) or from the last edit. Required for send: the send is bound to that exact draft and recipient, and a changed draft is refused. Optional for edit: when given, an edit of a changed draft is refused.
draft_version.title: Draft Version

subject.description: edit only: the new email subject.
subject.title: Subject

body.description: edit only: the new message text.
body.title: Body

recipient.description: edit only: the new email recipient. It must be an email address of a Person on this Deal.
recipient.title: Recipient

thread_id.description: edit only: a Gmail thread of this Deal to reply in, or "new" to start a new email.
thread_id.title: Thread Id

send_id.description: cancel only: the id of the scheduled send, from view_deal(include=["auto_sends"]).
send_id.title: Send Id
